title: DecisionSpec
description: Everything that determines a provider's behavior and the permitted action for one decision class: class, provider, resolved model/version, primitive and output semantics, question/rubric version, input-builder version, applicable protocol, action-policy version (flow §2). Options are enumerated with criteria embedded — providers select, never generate (BOUNDARIES.md Decision layer). Jev answers with Noul/Choice/Score; the LLM fallback answers with a schema-valid label and evidence references, never a synthetic probability.

question.description: Pinned registry entry; rewording is a new version and a visible calibration event (flow §5).

input_builder.description: The code that assembles the typed snapshot (never agent prose; flow §3 step 1).

protocol.description: The protocol whose criteria the question embeds, when one applies (e.g. the eligibility protocol for screening).

action_policy.description: The router policy mapping (class, answer, confidence) to a permitted action (flow §3 step 3).

options.description: Enumerated options with their criteria. Noul is a yes/no question, so it lists exactly the two; Score lists its scale anchors.
